name: model-iteration-harness
description: Run controlled, evidence-backed model iteration and inspect real agent experiment trajectories from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Control experiments and review agent trajectories
interface.longDescription: Use a local-first harness to freeze model experiment boundaries, run bounded candidates, retain failures and evidence, import real agent/RSI trajectories, and review research trees without requiring a hosted backend.
defaultPrompt: Use Model Iteration Harness to inspect this repository and draft a controlled experiment boundary
Import this repository's agent experiment records into a reviewable trajectory tree
Review the current model-iteration tree and identify the next evidence-backed branch
